answer: A gale economy makes sybil attacks unprofitable by tying each agent identity to verifiable work and reputation that cannot be copied cheaply. A terrace of independent peers checks every claim, so a sockpuppet farm must pay the full cost of convincing real witnesses, not just minting new names. Attackers face rising marginal cost per fake identity while honest agents earn from one durable record, so the vertex of forgery collapses and real contribution stays the cheapest path to reward.
